description: Pharma and biotech deals in your space: licenses, partnerships, options, acquisitions and collaborations with disclosed terms. One table of deals (shared with Partnerships and Deal Comps as dealradar.deals), an events feed, and a weekly scan + digest of the largest disclosed deals run by Claude or ChatGPT.
whenToUse: Track deals in your modalities and indications with their disclosed terms, as comparables for your own business development, with a weekly digest of the largest disclosed deals and period totals.
whenNotToUse: Your own partnering pipeline (Partnerships), contract drafting (Contracts), valuation models, financings (Funding Radar), investment advice or estimating undisclosed terms.
